Name: Jehu, King of Israel
Summary: Jehu, son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, was anointed by Elisha's prophet, rode furiously to Jezreel, slew Jehoram and Jezebel, wiped out Ahab's house and Baal's worshippers, yet kept Jeroboam's calves.
KeyStory: Jehu anointed, slays Jehoram and Jezebel, and purges Baal.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Israel; Jezebel; Jehoshaphat, Son of Nimshi; Jehonadab, Son of Rechab; Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Hosea
LifeLesson: Zeal that purges others' sins but keeps its own is zeal half-finished.
